feeds.title: Arty Crafty Kids - A Creative Place for Kids
feeds.description: Arty Crafty Kids is packed with fun & easy and totally do-able Art and Craft Ideas for Kids!

feeds.title: Kids Craft Room - Creative Fun For Everyone!
feeds.description: Welcome to Kids Craft Room, bursting with art, crafts and activities for creative kids and moms. We love to share achievable ideas that make nurturing kids creativity easy and fun every day! We love sharing inspirational art and craft ideas to enjoy with children throughout the year.

feeds.title: Mum In The Madhouse
feeds.description: Sharing tips and ideas to make parenting a little less insane - from one mad house to another. We hope to fill your with inspiration to live your life with your family. Come with us as we make our journey through life enjoying the small things and choosing joy daily. We craft, play, enjoy art, construct, cook and laugh our way through life.

feeds.title: Crafts on Sea
feeds.description: Creative inspiration for family life with achievable ideas you really can do. Crafts for kids, sensory play ideas, free colouring pages and more. Crafts for adults and their kids, family life by the seaside.

feeds.title: Sum of their Stories Blog
feeds.description: Craft tutorials and ideas. Sewing, Crochet, Knitting, Paper craft, Home decor, recipes, clothes refashions, upcycling and recycling projects and much more. Hi, I'm Julie and I've been dabbling in all sorts of crafts for as long as I can remember.

feeds.title: Craft Invaders
feeds.description: Providing original craft tutorials, recipes, foraging, the Cotswolds, and developing well-being through being creative, spending time outdoors and connecting with nature. Our aim is to inspire you to create, explore and discover. Craft Invaders is the craft blog that loves to think up quirky, out-of-the-box craft ideas so you don't have to!

feeds.title: The Gingerbread House
feeds.description: The gingerbread house blog was started in 2005 and is my little space where I share the things that make me happy: from our family-friendly crafts, our family adventures, and my little DIY projects for the house.

feeds.title: Gentleman Crafter
feeds.description: My name is John Bloodworth and I am, like you, a craft enthusiast and have been so for over 30 years. Through this blog I hope to share that journey with you as I bumble my way through all sorts of creative projects and experimentation. I also hope that you will share your experiences with me, and the other readers of this blog.

feeds.title: Pootles
feeds.description: Independent Stampin' Up! demonstrator, bespoke gift packaging and box designer. Supplier of all things gorgeously crafty for the consumer of paper, stamps, cards, inks and tools!

feeds.title: Craft with Cartwright - Crafting my life
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Ruth and I am the creative force behind Craft with Cartwright. I'm thirty seven, from the West Midlands and I am a vegetarian and a Coeliac. I am a craftswoman at heart, I love to draw, cook, sew and read. Luckily my children share my passions and we love to share this with everyone on my blog.

feeds.title: Rachael Jess
feeds.description: Recently qualified as an Interior Designer, my blog focuses on Home Decor, Makes, Reviews & Product Testings, family fun, caring for the environment and current news issues. Based in Sussex, there are often posts on What to do in and around Sussex and neighbouring counties for both couples and families.

feeds.title: Louise Sims Papercrafter
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Louise Sims aka Lou or Lulu. I share cards, mixed media projects, scrapbook pages, mini albums, and lots more - anything crafty basically. I'd love it if you would follow me on my crafty journey.

feeds.title: Jennifer's Little World Blog - Parenting, craft and travel
feeds.description: I'm Jennifer Jain. Blogging about me and my family, the crafts that we do, the places that we visit, and the things that we get up to.

feeds.title: Louise Sims Papercrafter
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Louise Sims aka Lou or Lulu. Thank you for popping over and please feel free to have a nose around. I share cards, mixed media projects, scrapbook pages, mini albums and lots more - anything crafty basically. I'd love it if you would follow me on my crafty journey.

feeds.title: The Craft Spa - Stampin' Up! UK independent demonstrator
feeds.description: Amanda Bates at The Craft Spa. Paper Crafting projects, tutorials and supplies. Independent Stampin' Up! demonstrator UK.

feeds.title: Intatwyne Designs
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Angelina and I'm a crafting addict. I've battled with it for most of my life off and on but over the last few years it has almost taken over. I started by making a few cards and learning a few paper folding techniques but as the years have gone on and crafting has expanded I found myself getting more and more addicted.

feeds.title: The Crafty Hen Blog
feeds.description: Your go to place for the best craft party ideas, handmade wedding trends, upcoming craft event experiences & all things Crafty Hen! Helping you organise a hand picked crafty party experience to celebrate special occasions UK-wide. A unique opportunity to create & make memories with friends.

feeds.title: Asking For Trouble
feeds.description: Marceline blogs about illustration, Japan, crafts and the freelance life. Asking For Trouble is a collection of stationery, accessories and gifts featuring my cute characters inspired by Japanese kawaii.

feeds.title: The Imagination Tree
feeds.description: My name is Anna and I am a primary school teacher from the UK with a specialism in early years education and art. You will find plenty of ideas for art and crafts, imaginative play, creativity, science investigations, early maths ideas and lots of fun!

feeds.title: Bugs and Fishes by Lupin
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Laura, aka Lupin. Welcome to my crafty universe! Visit my blog for free tutorials & other crafty goodness.

feeds.title: PartiCraft (Participate In Craft) Blog
feeds.description: A daily papercrafting blog which features my handmade cards showcasing Creative Expression's products including my own line of cutting dies and embossing folders, Cosmic Shimmer, Ranger and more which use various techniques and ideas to hopefully inspire the creativity in you.

feeds.title: Blissful Domestication
feeds.description: Hi I'm Kerry, Wife to James, Step Mum to one, Mum to two and more fur, feather and winged babies than I can count. I have a passion for crafts, encouraging creativity and inspiring imagination especially in children. So if you are looking for some inspiration, ideas and resources to inject a little creativity into your family life, then you've come to the right place.

feeds.title: Positively Papercraft
feeds.description: A daily craft blog about card making and lots of 3D craft projects. My name is Ann and I am a UK independent Stampin Up demonstrator based in the north east of England. I am addicted to paper crafts!

feeds.title: Handmade by Kim
feeds.description: Welcome to Handmade by Kim! My name is Kim Price and I'm an independent Stampin' Up! demonstrator from Bridgwater, Somerset, UK. I love to create and I enjoy many crafts! You will find here handmade cards and papercraft projects that I've created with Stampin' Up! products.

feeds.title: Craftaholique
feeds.description: Craftaholique is a UK craft blog powered by a passion for beading and jewellery making. You'll find free craft tutorials, ideas and inspiration on this craft blog.

feeds.title: EvinOK
feeds.description: This blog shares my love of knitting, crafting, sewing, making things with my sons, and baking. Find interesting and daily tid bits from life.

feeds.title: Heathers Inspiration
feeds.description: As a crafter myself I love to share ideas here on the blog. This includes a mix of cardmaking and craft makes, product information etc.

feeds.title: Mitosu Crafts Blog
feeds.description: Card Making and Papercraft creative coaches based in Basingstoke UK. For project ideas, inspirations, classes, events and Stampin' Up!

feeds.title: Papercraft Artistry
feeds.description: A place to share crafty ideas. Papercraft Artistry is authored by Sarah McDermott - Independent Stampin' Up! Demonstrator.

feeds.title: Made By Me Crafts
feeds.description: Handcrafted gifts and keepsakes, from cake toppers to fun quirky pebble pets, and more!

feeds.title: A handmade cottage - The craft blog
feeds.description: 'A handmade cottage' is a craft and natural beauty blog - Inspiring others into crafting cosy characterful homes with easy projects, patterns and ideas.

feeds.title: Crafting Fingers | When one craft isn't enough
feeds.description: I'm Anna. I love to craft and use sewing, crochet, knitting, macrame, and other techniques to make home decor and practical accessories. I share DIY tutorials as I learn and perfect new techniques so other makers can learn them too.

feeds.title: Red Ted Art's - Easy Crafts for Kids Blog
feeds.description: Fun, easy and 'do-able' crafts for kids and grown ups. Using every day materials, making DIY a great activity to do together. With successful and gorgeous projects and results. Keep them. Treasure them or create wonderful gifts for friends and family.

feeds.title: Craft Hustle Directory
feeds.description: Hello and Welcome to Craft Hustle Directory! My name is Charlotte and I'm a blogger and crafter from Essex with a love for learning new skills and starting creative small businesses. The purpose of Craft Hustle Directory is to teach you to do exactly the same. Follow the blog to know more.

feeds.title: Crafter's Companion
feeds.description: Find out the latest goings-on from Sara and the rest of the Crafter's Companion team.

feeds.title: The Crafty Gentleman
feeds.description: The Crafty Gentleman is a DIY and craft blog for men. It's full of DIY tutorials, craft ideas, and recipes, as well as creative inspiration and tips.

feeds.title: Crafter's Companion
feeds.description: A wide range of papercraft and needlecraft products as well as expert tutorials for both the budding creative and the experienced crafter alike. If you're looking to find out more about our latest launches, read news or simply find a bit of inspiration, our blog is the place for you.

feeds.title: Bibi Cameron
feeds.description: A blog to share the joy of papercraft and promote beautiful supplies for your crafts.

feeds.title: Oakfield Crafts
feeds.description: An inspiring craft blog where, Independent Stampin' Up! Demonstrator, Fiona Whitten from Oakfield Crafts shares her love of stamping and paper-crafting through her projects and ideas.

feeds.title: Creative Crafting
feeds.description: Creative Crafting Magazine was first published in October 2009 by a group of online crafting friends. Over the next five years we produced nearly 30 magazines and specials. We featured handmade products, stories, competitions, facts and many other craft related things.

feeds.title: Craft Focus Magazine
feeds.description: Craft Focus magazine is the UK's leading bi-monthly publication for the craft industry, for Art and Craft, Toy and Model shops, Haberdashers and Needlecraft retailers.

feeds.title: Shelley Makes | DIY blog from a closet crafter
feeds.description: Hello! My name is Shelley and this is my humble craft blog. On my blog you'll find everything from origami Easter bunnies, to breeze-block Halloween tombstones. Proud to be an 'Arts & Culture' Finalist in the UK Blog Awards 2016. Look forward to crafting with you!

feeds.title: Crafts Council
feeds.description: We are the national development agency for the contemporary crafts in the UK. Our goal is to make the UK the best place to make, see, collect and learn about contemporary craft.
